Scene 01

FALLS CHURCH, VIRGINIA

Monica Reyes

Thanks for the beer.

John Doggett

Thanks for the lift.

Monica Reyes

So, big plans for the weekend?

John Doggett

Oh, huge. Microwave pizza, satellite TV.

Monica Reyes

Wow. Thanks for making my life sound exciting. Maybe we both need pets. They say people with pets live longer.

John Doggett

I was thinking about getting a cat.

Monica Reyes

There's dog people, and there's cat people. You are a dog person, John.

John Doggett

How do you figure?

[ chuckles ]

Monica Reyes

You're faithful, you're dependable. You're without guile. You're very comfortable to be around. So why a cat?

John Doggett

Low maintenance. They don't expect much from you, so you can't disappoint 'em.

Monica Reyes

I don't see you ever disappointing anyone, John.

John Doggett

See you monday?

Monica Reyes

Yeah. See ya. John, John, John.

Scene 04

Stephen murdoch. I-I don't even know if that matters anymore but my name is stephen. Did you just look outside? Yeah. Don't do that.

Val Barreiro

Scene 06

Scene 07

Monica Reyes

Stephen Murdoch

I didn't say this was heaven. For all I know, it's-- it's hell. I don't know anything for sure. Maybe this place is a way station; a stop on the road to what comes next. Where are you going?

Monica Reyes

John--

Dr. Jack Preijers

In these situations, time is always of the essence. There is a woman in minnesota who can be saved by your friend's heart. In a real sense, she will live on.

Scene 11

John Doggett

What about this? This was monitoring her brain activity, right? Electrical impulses.

Dana Scully

Yeah. She had eeg monitoring after the point that she coded.

John Doggett

Suddenly they just stop here. Right here. And if we can learn what this is, maybe we can reverse it.

Dana Scully

Agent Doggett.

Scene 12

Monica Reyes

Different than barriero.

Scene 18

Dana Scully

What exactly are you thinking?

John Doggett

She helped work on Monica. I started asking questions about what happened in the trauma bay, and she very inconveniently drops dead.

Dana Scully

John Doggett

Well, if it were you, how would you go about it, make it look like natural causes?

Dana Scully

Well, I'd use a fast-acting barbiturate like pentobarbital. I'd use a small-bore needle to make it next to impossible to find an injection mark.

Dana Scully

Agent Doggett... I'm happy to do this for you. Just don't kid yourself that this is going to somehow bring her back.

[ sighs ]
